hooks.text: 英雄可把笨重防御塔缩成便携形态，战斗中重新摆放整条防线
hooks.excerpt: Fran has the ability to use Wish Power to shrink bulky defense towers into portable forms and rearrange them on the battlefield.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 五名Whicken战士可被强化并转化为十五种高阶Spirit Tower
hooks.excerpt: The five humble Whicken tribe warriors can be empowered and transformed into 15 different advanced Spirit Towers, resurrecting the glory of past battlefields!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 祭司Pani拥有九种英雄形态，可在关键战斗中变身扭转局势
hooks.excerpt: Pani, with her 9 different forms, is your most reliable companion in adventure and battle, although she has a temper.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 画面在PC端看来糊的一批
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 像素奇幻塔防画面华丽。

excerpts.excerpt: a gorgeous pixel art fantasy tower defense game.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 内容量偏少且定价过高。
第五章敌人种类明显少于前面章节。

excerpts.excerpt: Chapter 5 is the final area in the game yet has less enemies than any other area by a huge margin.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 狙击塔强到可以通刷多数关卡，平衡较差。

excerpts.excerpt: 狙击塔可以刷几乎所有关卡，过于超模
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 建造者移动缓慢，让建塔和升级变成耗时事务。

excerpts.excerpt: a slow cumbersome builder that makes the most basic tasks like building towers and upgrading them a time consuming chore.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 英雄工具包强弱高度不均，选择常被效率而非乐趣支配。

excerpts.excerpt: you’re picking them based 99% on which has the most efficient skills
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 隐藏秘密和彩蛋带来很多快乐时刻。

excerpts.excerpt: gives you a lot of joy and funny moments as you discover hidden secrets and easter eggs
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 整体玩法有趣且有个性。
移动塔位为塔防玩法增加了有趣变化。

excerpts.excerpt: repositioning your towers, which adds an interesting twist to the TD genre.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

baseline.message: 首期基线，暂无可比趋势。

risks: 内容量偏少且定价过高。
第五章敌人种类明显少于前面章节。
狙击塔强到可以通刷多数关卡，平衡较差。
建造者移动缓慢，让建塔和升级变成耗时事务。
英雄工具包强弱高度不均，选择常被效率而非乐趣支配。
